description: One row per residential telecom customer, capturing subscribed services, account/contract attributes, billing amounts, and whether the customer churned. Source: Kaggle blastchar/telco-customer-churn (IBM Telco Customer Churn sample dataset).
grain: One row per customer (customerID), snapshot at time of extract.
business_owner: [simulated stakeholder input] VP of Customer Retention
technical_owner: [simulated stakeholder input] Data Science / Analytics team (this project)
upstream_sources: Kaggle dataset export (static, one-time download for this lab); in production this would be the billing system + CRM.
downstream_consumers: Retention team ranked risk list (planned deliverable)
sensitivity: PII (customerID is a pseudonymous key; gender, SeniorCitizen are demographic attributes) + billing/financial (MonthlyCharges, TotalCharges)
compliance_tags: none applicable - public Kaggle sample; would be PII/financial in a real production telecom system

columns.name: customerID
columns.business_definition: Unique customer identifier assigned at account creation. Primary key.

columns.name: gender
columns.business_definition: Customer's self-reported gender at signup (Male/Female, as captured by this legacy system).

columns.name: SeniorCitizen
columns.business_definition: Whether the account holder is 65+ (1) or not (0), self-reported at signup.

columns.name: Partner
columns.business_definition: Whether the customer has a partner (spouse/domestic partner) on the account profile.

columns.name: Dependents
columns.business_definition: Whether the customer has dependents (children/other dependents) on the account profile.

columns.name: tenure
columns.business_definition: Number of months the customer has been with the company as of the snapshot date. Used as the acquisition-to-date clock (business framing: months since acquisition).

columns.name: PhoneService
columns.business_definition: Whether the customer subscribes to the phone service line.

columns.name: MultipleLines
columns.business_definition: Whether the customer has multiple phone lines (No / Yes / No phone service).

columns.name: InternetService
columns.business_definition: Internet service technology subscribed to (DSL / Fiber optic / No internet service).

columns.name: OnlineSecurity
columns.business_definition: Whether the customer subscribes to the online security add-on (requires internet service).

columns.name: OnlineBackup
columns.business_definition: Whether the customer subscribes to the online backup add-on (requires internet service).

columns.name: DeviceProtection
columns.business_definition: Whether the customer subscribes to the device protection add-on (requires internet service).

columns.name: TechSupport
columns.business_definition: Whether the customer subscribes to the tech support add-on (requires internet service).

columns.name: StreamingTV
columns.business_definition: Whether the customer subscribes to the streaming TV add-on (requires internet service).

columns.name: StreamingMovies
columns.business_definition: Whether the customer subscribes to the streaming movies add-on (requires internet service).

columns.name: Contract
columns.business_definition: Contract commitment term: Month-to-month, One year, or Two year. Primary churn-risk driver dimension.

columns.name: PaperlessBilling
columns.business_definition: Whether the customer is enrolled in paperless billing (Yes/No).

columns.name: PaymentMethod
columns.business_definition: How the customer pays their bill (Electronic check, Mailed check, Bank transfer (automatic), Credit card (automatic)).

columns.name: MonthlyCharges
columns.business_definition: Current recurring monthly charge in USD - treated as the customer's MRR contribution (business framing).

columns.name: TotalCharges
columns.business_definition: Cumulative amount billed to the customer to date (USD). Approximately tenure x MonthlyCharges, with small deviations from mid-cycle rate changes; blank for 11 customers with tenure=0 (billed nothing yet).
columns.notes: Ships as object dtype (blank strings for tenure=0 rows); 11 rows become null after pd.to_numeric coercion (see data/processed/dataset_meta.json).

columns.name: Churn
columns.business_definition: Target label: whether the customer churned (voluntarily left) during the observation window (Yes/No).
